quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026, consolidated, K-IFRS, reviewed by Daejoo Accounting): revenue KRW 720,170M vs KRW 493,909M in H1 2025 (+46%); gross profit KRW 179,776M (25.0% GM); operating profit KRW 144,285M (20.0% margin) vs KRW 89,754M (+61%); net income KRW 110,152M vs KRW 69,670M (+58%); basic EPS KRW 1,501 vs 1,033. Q2 alone: revenue KRW 379,888M (vs KRW 241,419M a year ago, +57% YoY; +12% QoQ vs Q1 KRW 340,282M), operating profit KRW 77,064M (vs KRW 42,070M, +83% YoY; 20.3% margin), net income KRW 59,709M. FY2025 reference: revenue KRW 1,088,025M / OP KRW 204,725M. MIX: own-manufactured PCB 95.92% (KRW 690,758M), traded PCB 4.08% (KRW 29,412M); exports >97% of sales. Average export selling price KRW 4,875,174/m2 vs KRW 4,477,422 for FY2025 (+8.9%) and KRW 3,739,531 for FY2024, attributed by the filing to a higher share of high-value products. GEOGRAPHY (consolidated, by customer location): Thailand KRW 209,334M, Mexico KRW 133,668M, Taiwan KRW 107,653M, other countries KRW 248,069M, Korea KRW 21,445M (Taiwan +88% YoY, Mexico +50%, other +79%). Parent (separate) revenue KRW 584,593M / OP KRW 100,771M; China subsidiary ISU Petasys Asia (Hunan plant) revenue KRW 165,490M / net income KRW 26,141M in H1. Balance sheet at 2026-06-30: cash KRW 144,347M plus KRW 89,792M short-term deposits; receivables KRW 343,275M (up from KRW 214,127M at 2025-12-31); inventories KRW 374,429M (up from KRW 298,792M); total borrowings KRW 269,229M; debt-to-equity 70.6%; net debt ratio 3.6% (net cash at year-end 2025). Operating cash flow was NEGATIVE KRW 49,616M (vs +KRW 49,495M) because receivables grew KRW 117,322M and inventories KRW 78,128M on the sales ramp; PP&E purchases KRW 79,059M (vs KRW 50,789M). Korea Ratings raised the corporate rating to BBB+ / stable on 2026-05-12 (from BBB / positive on 2025-11-26). Filing narrative: demand expanded sharply across AI accelerators, switches and servers; Plant 4 in full mass production with automation of the older plants; 2026 growth expected from front-end demand, the Plant 5 expansion effect and production-site optimisation across the China and Thailand entities.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 rev KRW 720.2B (+46% YoY); OP KRW 144.3B (20.0% margin, +61%); Q2 rev KRW 379.9B (+57% YoY), Q2 OP KRW 77.1B (+83%); export ASP +8.9% vs FY2025; OCF -KRW 49.6B on working capital

quarterly_data.signal: Orders and customers (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026, as of 2026-06-30): H1 2026 NEW ORDERS KRW 836,195M (147,923 m2) vs KRW 571,375M delivered (117,064 m2) - a 1.46x book-to-bill; ORDER BACKLOG KRW 622,180M (109,714 m2) at 2026-06-30, up from KRW 573.7B at 2026-03-31 (+8.5% QoQ) and equal to ~1.6x Q2 revenue. CUSTOMER CONCENTRATION: one customer (anonymised customer A) is 40.1% of consolidated H1 revenue (KRW 288,666M, up from KRW 208,600M / 42.2% a year ago); on the parent's separate books three customers exceeded 10% - A KRW 274,762M, B KRW 60,679M (up 2.5x from KRW 23,954M), C KRW 39,575M - together 57.4% of parent revenue. Filing states products go mainly to global big-tech companies - data-center, AI and network-equipment makers - sold direct (Americas direct supply), ~60-day payment after shipment. Hyperscale server market: of the CSPs holding >60% of the global data-center market the company has secured 'G' and 'M' as customers and is in talks with 'A' for new entry. AI accelerators: 'G' and 'N' are the main customers, both are expected to have the company participate in and mass-produce their NEXT-GENERATION models, and new AI-accelerator customers are being pursued, so AI-accelerator revenue is expected to keep expanding; the filing notes that 'N' dominates GPUs while 'A' and other big techs accelerate in-house AI ASICs (chiplet, 2.5D/3D packaging, HBM) - the structural driver of ultra-multilayer MLB demand. Networking: 800G switch MASS PRODUCTION has started, with switch/router bandwidth moving 400G to 800G to 1.6T. Trade receivables rose to KRW 328,977M (99.49% under 6 months).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 new orders KRW 836.2B (1.46x deliveries); backlog KRW 622.2B at 06-30-2026 (+8.5% QoQ); customer A 40.1% of sales; 800G switch mass production started

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and capex (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): Daegu plant capacity 119 thousand m2 in H1 2026 (annualised ~238k vs 228k m2 for FY2025 and 200k for FY2024), production 115 thousand m2 (vs 214k for all of FY2025), UTILISATION 96.8% (3,642 of 3,763 available hours; 21.5 hours/day, 175 working days) - effectively full. CAPEX PROGRAMME KRW 400,000M total: (1) new plant construction and capacity expansion (Plant 5) KRW 352,300M over 2025-2028, KRW 109,712M spent and KRW 242,588M remaining; (2) capacity expansion and replacement of aged equipment KRW 47,700M in 2025, fully spent. KRW 157,412M of the KRW 282,526M raised in the 2025-04-17 rights offering (10,162,800 shares at KRW 27,800) had been deployed by 2026-06-30 for Plants 1-4 expansion, Plant 5 and capacity additions; the remainder is to be spent per the 2025-04-07 prospectus. Construction-in-progress KRW 133,166M at 2026-06-30; machinery net book value rose to KRW 126,177M from KRW 88,919M at year-end (KRW 43,737M transferred from CIP in H1); H1 PP&E additions KRW 86,299M. Construction contract with related party Isu Construction for the new plant has an unbilled balance of KRW 123,170M. Funding: board approved a new KDB facility loan on 2026-05-11 (long-term borrowings +KRW 40,000M in H1); government subsidies of KRW 40,000M (reshoring-company subsidy, conditions run to 2031-05) and KRW 3,000M (regional investment, to 2030-09) support the domestic plant build. Board registered a new Guji plant business site on 2026-02-20. Filing: Plant 4 in full mass production; Plant 5 staged expansion under way to build a multi-lamination high-value production system; China (Hunan) and Thailand entities being used to optimise production sites by product group, shorten lead times and cut cost. Inventories KRW 374,429M (25.5% of assets; work-in-process KRW 197,692M) with KRW 20,389M valuation allowance.
quarterly_data.figure: Utilisation 96.8% (H1 capacity 119k m2, output 115k m2); KRW 400B capex plan, KRW 157.4B spent, KRW 242.6B to go (Plant 5, 2025-2028); CIP KRW 133.2B

quarterly_data.signal: Pipeline and corporate events (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): R&D programmes - (1) 1600G Data Center Networking PCB, 2025-01 to 2028-12 (1.6T signal-integrity design, back-drill stub-length minimisation hardware/software, 3D SI simulation); (2) AI accelerator PCB, 2023-05 to 2026-12 (high-density stacked micro-via and high-aspect-ratio via stabilisation); (3) new materials and processes, 2021-09 to 2026-12 (cavity-structure PCB for 1600G, super-ultra-low-loss and ultra-low-loss halogen-free materials). H1 R&D spend KRW 4,840M (0.84% of revenue), 50 staff. Filing: 800G switch mass production has started and bandwidth is transitioning 400G to 800G to 1.6T; key AI-accelerator requirements are dielectric-loss reduction, skew management and PI/SI optimisation for GPU/TPU boards; customers 'G' and 'N' next-generation accelerator models to be mass-produced. Shareholder-return roadmap (value-up plan of 2025-04-30, progress report 2026-04-30): cumulative investment through 2028 will exceed cumulative net income while Plant 5 is built; separate-basis dividend payout to rise gradually to 25-30% by 2029 and a more active return policy after Plant 5 completes in 2028 (FY2025 payout 10.7%, DPS KRW 230 paid 2026-03). Credit rating BBB+ / stable (Korea Ratings, 2026-05-12). Contingency: KRW 15,813M deposit for the withdrawn Jeio share purchase (contract withdrawn 2025-01) remains a long-term receivable under litigation filed 2025-03-21 (claim KRW 16,112M; counter-suit filed 2025-05-30). Korea Exchange fined the company KRW 60M and 6 penalty points on 2025-02-28 for disclosure reversal.
quarterly_data.figure: 1.6T networking PCB R&D to 2028-12; AI-accelerator PCB programme to 2026-12; 800G switch in mass production; payout target 25-30% by 2029 after Plant 5 (2028)
